description: Signs, Signals, and Codes explores how people communicate without ordinary speech or writing: Morse code, American Sign Language, semaphore and nautical flags, braille, sound and silent signals, trail signs, hand signals, traffic and map symbols, and secret codes.
outlineNote: Excerpts were partly garbled and did not show numbering, so no requirement outline is published yet. The badge emphasizes awareness of each system rather than mastery.
